comparison_variable: measured right-front-wheel contact to curb-face distance while stopped loading
fixed_conditions: same non-tour bus, loading place, public street and other vehicle
same entry duration and longitudinal route
same four-camera acquisition and traffic controller policy
native_source_requirements: original right-front wheel contact geometry and calibrated curb face
original bus heading, speed and passenger or baggage loading activity
original other-vehicle route, speed and delay during bus entry and loading
original Native frame/time and all four source-camera identities
independently sourced non-tour classification and qualifying public-street loading location

source_observation_terms_mapped.ru.bus: sourced non-tour bus classification and Native identity
source_observation_terms_mapped.st.curb_zone: sourced loading zone or bus stop location
source_observation_terms_mapped.rel.surface_gap: right-front wheel contact to curb-face metric distance
source_observation_terms_mapped.kin.heading: bus heading difference against curb tangent
source_observation_terms_mapped.drv.stopped: observed Native bus speed during loading
source_observation_terms_mapped.sig.door_open: loading activity source, with door signal insufficient by itself
source_observation_terms_mapped.drv.queue_behind: other vehicle route, speed and delay observations
source_observation_terms_mapped.kin.extent: bus body geometry remains separate from wheel contact geometry

approximately_parallel: independent judgment, no invented numeric cutoff
unduly_impede: independent judgment, no invented numeric cutoff
numeric_boundary_diagnostic: wheel gap <= 0.4572 m, exactly 18 inches; approximate parallelism and undue impedance remain separate judgments
